title: Cobblemon: Void
description: A Cobblemon Addon that adds Pokemon from the fangame Pokemon Void.
body: A datapack that adds Pokemon from the popular fangame "Pokemon Void". As of now, only Sedimite and a few evolutions are available. Go support the [Pokedex Fillers!](https://www.youtube.com/@pokedexfillers/featured) on Youtube and join their discord for devlogs on the datapack!
